about.titulo: Leadership, taught the way it's actually learned
about.parrafo1: Tango Para La Vida is a program by TangoMJ — a portfolio of experiential programs that use Argentine Tango as a practical laboratory for leadership, communication, collaboration and self-awareness, built for organizations, leadership teams and professionals who want stronger communication, trust and more effective collaboration.
about.parrafo2: We believe the most important lessons in leadership aren't learned from a slide deck — they're learned in the body, through real connection with another person. Every program we run is built around that idea: put people in an unfamiliar, embodied experience together, and watch communication, trust and leadership show up in ways a classroom never reveals.

pilares.descripcion: Movement and connection are the classroom — not slides.
Every session translates directly into how your team communicates and leads back at work.
People remember what they feel. Growth happens outside the comfort zone, together.

facilitadores.intro: Tango Para La Vida is created and facilitated by Maddalena and Joel — professional tango teachers who bring coaching, NLP and non-verbal communication into every session.

items.bio: Maddalena has spent years teaching Argentine Tango, developing a sharp eye for how connection, trust and hesitation show up in the body before anyone says a word. She combines her background as a dance instructor with coaching and non-verbal communication tools, helping participants notice patterns in themselves they'd never catch in a normal meeting.

Joel teaches tango and trains leaders, blending years on the dance floor with coaching and NLP (neuro-linguistic programming). He's especially drawn to the moment a group stops thinking about the steps and starts actually listening to each other — and he designs every session to get there faster.

faq.subtitulo: Everything you need to know before reaching out.

items.pregunta: What is Tango Para La Vida?
items.respuesta: Tango Para La Vida is a portfolio of experiential programs that use Argentine Tango as a practical laboratory for leadership, communication, collaboration and self-awareness — designed for organizations, leadership teams and professionals.

items.pregunta: Which program is right for our organization?
items.respuesta: It depends on your goal and the time you have. Tango Connection Experience (2 hours) is ideal for a single event, Dance of Collaboration (3–4 hours) suits a team workshop, and Embodied Leadership Lab (5–6 hours) is a full leadership development day.

Normal is the right starting point for most teams — it includes a full workshop plus a pre-session call and follow-up. Basic works well for a single lighter-touch session, and Premium suits organizations planning a multi-session leadership journey.

items.pregunta: Who are these programs designed for?
items.respuesta: Primarily leadership teams, entrepreneurs, IT companies, SMEs and family businesses — as well as healthcare organizations, physiotherapy practices, wellbeing organizations, yoga & mindfulness communities and education organizations.

items.pregunta: What will my team actually take away?
items.respuesta: A direct, embodied experience of trust, communication and collaboration — insights like "trust is built through shared experience" and "communication goes beyond words" that stay with participants long after the session ends.

items.pregunta: How do we book a program?
items.respuesta: Reach out through the contact form below or book a discovery call, and we'll help you choose the right level, package and schedule for your team.
